title: TJM Cluster Centre
description: Pages of engine, gearbox, xDrive and eDrive data, warm-up, turbo cool-down, a shift light and a 0-60 timer in the centre of the factory cluster, drawn by the cluster itself

de.bmw.infrastructure.analytics.BasicDat._optional: gearbox oil temperature; the xDrive split then comes from the transfer case or the drive mode

de.bmw.infotainment.drivingexcitement.Ef._optional: the battery's temperature (eDrive Live's is used instead)

de.bmw.infotainment.KombiIF._optional: the car's power distribution figures, and its fuel and electric ranges

settings.label: Vehicle
options: Plug-in hybrid (charge, electric range, battery power)
Petrol or diesel (boost, timing, torque, fuel rail)

settings.label: Battery readings (plug-in hybrid)
options: Read the battery unit (charge, power) when the car has one
Off: from eDrive Live or the car only

settings.label: Look
options: Like the factory cluster (thin, no boxes)

settings.label: Size in the centre
options: The whole middle (the stock speed and range cover its edges)

settings.label: Shift light and gear at the top
Electric range when full (until the car's own is found)

gearboxTemp.note: a value that never changes is shown as no data (some cars don't fill this field); raw values go to the log ('raw gearbox oil')

boost.note: sport display boost; raw values go to the log ('raw FES boost')

torque.note: 12 bit, 0.5 Nm per bit, 0 Nm at raw 2047 (negative = engine braking), 4095 = no value. With factor 1 a running engine read as ~2047 Nm.

tyreTemp.note: degrees + 40, in the car's temperature unit (deg F on a car set to Fahrenheit: main.js converts it): a G05 PHEV sent raw 53-57 on a ~10 deg C day (2.8.0 log), not deci-Kelvin. Values outside -40..150 deg C are shown as no data; the raw values go to the log ('raw tyre temperature')

tyrePress.note: 0.1 per bit in the car's pressure unit (bar / kPa / psi, from Vehicle.statusNewCurrentUnitsStatusExt; main.js converts it to bar). BMW x_call: raw * 0.1, valid up to 530; a car in bar sent raw 22-25 = 2.2-2.5 bar, a car in psi about 410 = 41 psi. Read as 0.1 kPa before, every tyre came out at 0.02 bar and was hidden.

sportPct.note: sport display power / torque in % of the car maximum; calibrate if the raw value is not 0-100

batteryTemp.comment: Efficiencytainment2.statusBatteryTemperature (X5 45e: raw 76 with the cells at ~26 C)

yaw.note: deg/s; the factor and offset of the car's CAN yaw-rate signal, not yet confirmed on this field: the raw values show on Cluster Layouts' Signals page and go to the log ('raw statusYawVelocityVehicle')

steer.note: degrees at the wheel, negative to the right as BMW counts; the CAN steering-angle factor, signed 16 bit, not yet confirmed on this field: raw values on the Signals page and in the log

xdrive.comment: xDrive split straight from the transfer case unit (LMV, address 0x19), read on the Chassis page when the car's own split signal has nothing. LMV_MOMENT (22 DB32): actual torque to the front axle, signed, Nm = raw / 4 (bytes 0-1); qualifier bytes 2-3, target torque 4-5 (layout from BMW's LMV_G11 description). Split % = front torque / (engine torque x gear ratio): an estimate (no converter multiplication, no losses).

front.note: LMV_MOMENT.ISTMOMENT, actual torque to the front axle

dme.comment: Intake / fuel values from the engine unit (DME, ecu 18 = 0x12) with UDS 0x22. F4xx = the standard OBD PIDs (F40F = PID 0x0F); a candidate with "obd" instead of "did" asks for the same PID with OBD service 01 (some engine units refuse the F4xx identifiers with NRC 31). Candidates are tried in order; the first plausible one wins. value = raw * factor + offset (bar / deg C). If a tile says 'not available from this DME', add your engine's BMW-specific DID here. boost: tried in order when the sport display sends no boost (setting 'Boost from'); absolute pressure in kPa, the outside air pressure (baro) is subtracted. boostTarget / boostActual: boost pressure setpoint and actual (absolute kPa, baro subtracted), BMW DIDs first, then OBD PID 0x70; the tile only shows when the target answers. loadTarget / loadActual: requested and actual relative air charge in %. timing: OBD PID 0x0E, degrees before top dead centre. misfire: OBD service 06 monitor results (MID A2 = cylinder 1, A3 = cylinder 2 ...), tid 0C = misfires this driving cycle (0B = average of the last 10 cycles); engine units that only speak UDS are asked 0x22 F6A2... egs: gearbox temperature from the gearbox unit (EGS); give each candidate its "ecu".

iat.note: charge air cooler temperature, bank 1 sensor 1
the same PID with OBD service 01, for engine units that refuse F40F with NRC 31

hpfp.note: fuel rail gauge pressure (direct injection), 10 kPa per bit
fuel rail absolute pressure, 10 kPa per bit

lpfp.note: fuel rail pressure relative to manifold, 0.079 kPa per bit

oil.note: engine oil temperature, OBD service 01 PID 0x5C - only read while the car's own signal (CDS) sends none

boost.note: OBD PID 0x70 boost pressure control: actual boost pressure sensor A (absolute), 1/32 kPa
OBD PID 0x87 intake manifold absolute pressure sensor A, 1/32 kPa
OBD PID 0x0B intake manifold absolute pressure, kPa (max 255 = 1.5 bar boost)

baro.note: OBD PID 0x33 barometric pressure, kPa (101.3 when not available)

boostTarget.note: BMW boost pressure setpoint (absolute), hPa = raw * 10 / 256
OBD PID 0x70: commanded boost pressure A (absolute), 1/32 kPa

boostActual.note: BMW boost pressure actual (absolute), hPa = raw * 10 / 256
OBD PID 0x70: boost pressure sensor A (absolute), 1/32 kPa

loadTarget.note: BMW requested relative air charge, % = raw * 0.75 / 32

loadActual.note: BMW actual relative air charge, % = raw * 0.75

timing.note: OBD service 01 PID 0x0E timing advance, degrees before TDC (cylinder 1)

misfire.note: set to {} to switch off; "ecu" to ask another unit

egs.note: ZF 8HP (GSZFBCE) _GETRIEBEOELTEMPERATUR, deg C + 40 (idrive7-apps PR #29, read on a G22)
gearbox unit (EGS, 0x18) transmission oil temperature, deg C + 48 (from a forum report, not confirmed on a car: only shown once it changes; the replies go to the log, "raw EGS")

config.comment: scaling, xdrive and dme as M Vitals (cauliflowermossgrape/idrive7-apps apps/car_vitals) reads them

battery.comment: the high-voltage battery unit (SME, ecu 7), as eDrive Live reads it (confirmed on the X5 45e): power = voltage x current x powerSign / 1000 (kW, + drawing)
